name: trustbridge
description: TrustBridge - Multi-tenant platform with fraud detection, real-time communication, and dispute management

scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npx --yes tsx --test backend/src/services/*.test.ts backend/src/config/*.test.ts frontend/src/utils/*.test.ts && npx --yes tsx backend/tests/test_all.ts
